test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ARMY is written as XOJV. How will CALCULATOR be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cba3e92827cd4eb698495fbf399ff8efa0f9f276872546800fe40e237cd31dad.png] 

The logic followed here is:

ARMY is written as XOJV.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb24ef34b5c10bb617569d0cb156087261622731f3875334741bd58eddeb40ec.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc528eb8773b9c705a7ecf543fc7cf857484e32b61de3e815fa5ff1606ac2de.png] 

Similarly, CALCULATOR will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78eb27fdaa09614602db204cfc1173e24fccba87824abccb0cbfe89f696fac89.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/226718c88ba453b3cc9813f4a156e909a1ffce82ace58fe515ec6a4e58323638.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "ZXIZRIXQLO".**
